reviewer: Independent Codex root reviewer; separate from evaluated model session

criteria.criterion: Evidence fidelity: numbers, units and claims match cited evidence.
criteria.rationale: The artifact and all ten structured citation claims match the supplied endpoints: request rate 60→120 requests/s, error rate 3→6 percent (+3 percentage points), p95 latency 625→1250 ms. It correctly distinguishes current CRITICAL signal severity from WARNING latency-regression severity.

criteria.criterion: Scope and time: origins, scope and baseline/current windows remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: It retains SIMULATED apm scope, the adjacent20-second windows ending01:05:52 Z and01:06:12 Z, capture time, and unverified retrieval/freshness; it makes no live-health claim.

criteria.criterion: Coverage: missing, empty, stale, partial and contradictory evidence stays explicit.
criteria.rationale: It preserves COMPLETE as collection completion, separately discloses profile PARTIAL/WARN, and leaves customer counts, duration and component-level evidence unknown.

criteria.criterion: Causality: ranked hypotheses, alternatives and counter-evidence do not become confirmed cause.
criteria.rationale: Load, checkout503-path and pre-existing bottleneck explanations remain hypotheses; baseline symptoms and endpoint-only correlation are explicit counter-evidence.

criteria.criterion: Action truth: proposed, approved, human-reported, executed and verified are distinguished.
criteria.rationale: The action record establishes no remediation, authorization, execution or measured recovery; structured actions are empty and publication remains draft.

criteria.criterion: Usefulness: the incident artifact gives concrete next checks and a usable handoff.
criteria.rationale: The handoff identifies temporal and component evidence needed to distinguish hypotheses, limits work to APM scope, and requires separately authorized fresh collection for current health.

scenarioSpecificCheck.expectation: Quantify the regression with the actual current/baseline values and preserve SIMULATED origin; no confirmed root cause.
scenarioSpecificCheck.rationale: The actual baseline comparison is quantified without converting signed regressions into a confirmed cause or production claim.
